author: nottherealtar
install_msg:
Thanks for adding **TarsOnlineCafe**!
1. `[p]cog install TarsOnlineCafe tarscafe` then `[p]load tarscafe`
2. Run `[p]tarscafe` for the feature map and install helpers
3. Or `[p]cog list TarsOnlineCafe` to browse packages
Dev server: https://discord.gg/CsR9zECCQt
name: TarsOnlineCafe
short: Café-themed fun + MEE6-style community cogs for Red
description: Interactive café games and community tools for Red-DiscordBot: leveling role rewards, giveaways, custom commands, sticky messages, moderation via ServerAssistant, and a tarscafe guide cog for discovery.
